# OpenPacks Duel developer documentation

- API contract: /openapi.yaml
- Quickstart: /guides/quickstart.md
- Solana transaction model: /guides/solana-transactions.md
- Canonical valuation and proof: /guides/valuation-and-proof.md
- Webhook verification: /guides/webhooks.md
- Escrow protocol: https://github.com/openpacksduel/escrow/blob/main/docs/protocol.md
- MCP server: https://github.com/openpacksduel/mcp
- Agent skills: https://github.com/openpacksduel/skills

The API contract is preview-only until its endpoints are deployed. Never provide
a wallet private key or seed phrase to OpenPacks Duel, its API, MCP server, or an
agent skill.
